ResearchProjectDef.label: beekeeping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Keep bees for honey and wax. Unlocks apiaries, mead and sweetrolls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: winemaking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow grapes and age their juice into wine. Unlocks grapes, must and wine barrels.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alchemy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Distil herbs and stranger things into potent draughts. Unlocks the alchemical draughts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: stonecutting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cut stone into blocks for building and paving. Unlocks the stonecutter's table, stone tiles and flagstones.

ResearchProjectDef.label: castle building
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise castle walls, gates and great doors. Unlocks the medieval architecture.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fine furniture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build proper beds, chairs, shelves and decorations. Unlocks the complex furniture.

ResearchProjectDef.label: carpet-making
ResearchProjectDef.description: Weave fabric into carpets and rugs. Unlocks carpets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: games
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make games of skill and chance, and targets to train on. Unlocks chess, poker and billiards tables, toy boxes and training targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: harp
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a harp and fill the halls with music. Unlocks the harp.

ResearchProjectDef.label: harpsichord
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a keyed instrument with plucked strings. Unlocks the harpsichord.

ResearchProjectDef.label: smithing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work metal at the forge into tools and fittings. Unlocks smithies and metal tiles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: complex workshops
ResearchProjectDef.description: Equip workshops with anvils, looms, racks and tools that speed up every craft. Unlocks the workshop facilities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bladesmithing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Forge metal weapons for close fighting. Unlocks maces, axes, gladii, shortswords and flails.

ResearchProjectDef.label: long blades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Forge long swords and polearms. Unlocks longswords, spears, warhammers, claymores, halberds and pikes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: war bows
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make bows and crossbows built for war, and axes for throwing. Unlocks the greatbow, warbow, arbalest and throwing axe.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gunpowder
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fire lead balls with black powder. Unlocks the hand cannon, arquebus, musket and flintlock.

ResearchProjectDef.label: siegecraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mount crossbows and guns on walls to hold a castle. Unlocks the wall-mounted arbalest and arquebus.

ResearchProjectDef.label: complex clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor shirts, trousers, dusters and hats. Unlocks the complex clothing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: noble dress
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make the fine clothes, robes and crowns of nobility. Unlocks noble and royal apparel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armoury
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make helmets, leather armour and shields. Unlocks simple helmets, leather armour and round shields.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plate armour
ResearchProjectDef.description: Encase a fighter in shaped steel plates. Unlocks plate armour, heavy helmets and heater shields.

ResearchProjectDef.label: scholarship
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study at desks and benches, and teach the young. Unlocks the simple research bench, bookcases, school desks, blackboards and study aids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heraldry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bear your house's colours on tabards, banners and rugs. Unlocks the heraldic items.
